_comment: Copy to models.json. Three roles, three different families; the script refuses two from one family. Ids are OpenRouter ids, checked against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models on the date given. They go stale; re-check before trusting. Reasoning effort defaults to low for a/b and medium for the adjudicator; override per role with a "reasoning" field, e.g. {"effort":"medium"} (see https://openrouter.ai/docs/use-cases/reasoning-tokens).

a.why: 2026-09-15: strong on code, $1.60/$3.20 per M tokens on OpenRouter, 1M context so a whole PR diff fits.

b.why: 2026-09-16: a GPT-5-class reviewer for the third family the pipeline needs by default (was z-ai/glm-5.3, which spent ~155k reasoning tokens reviewing a 3-file diff in the first live run; the reasoning cap below is the other half of that fix). $2.50/$15 per M tokens, 1.05M context, verified against https://openrouter.ai/api/v1/models on 2026-09-16.

adjudicator.why: 2026-09-15: third lineage, $0.75/$3.75 per M tokens; it only runs on disputed findings so a mid-price model is fine here.
